_provenance: awslabs.bedrock-kb-retrieval-mcp-server@1.1.2 (PyPI, uploaded 2026-09-22). NOT a live recording: no AWS account was available when this was written (2026-10-07). Derived from that exact version's published sdist (server.py, knowledgebases/*.py) and from how mcp 2.0.0's func_metadata renders a signature; pydantic `title` keys are left out. The server also registers AgenticQueryKnowledgeBases, which no route uses and which is not listed here. Re-record with a live `tools/list` when an operator profile is available.

tools.name: ListKnowledgeBases
tools.description: List all available Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and their data sources.

tools.name: QueryKnowledgeBases
tools.description: Query an Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base using natural language.

query.description: A natural language query to search the knowledge base with

knowledge_base_id.description: The knowledge base ID to query. It must be a valid ID from the ListKnowledgeBases tool
